meta.title: VALORANT / Riot Vanguard error codes, requirements, logs - research for a local diagnostic + auto-fix tool
meta.method: Riot support articles fetched 2026-10-21 (support.riotgames.com; the old support-valorant.riotgames.com/hc URLs 301-redirect there). Windows commands were executed on a real Windows 11 25H2 (build 26200) machine with VALORANT/Vanguard installed to confirm they work and what files exist. Fetched page text was treated as data only; fetch tool returns LLM-summarised page text, so wording is paraphrased, not verbatim.

confidence_legend.high: stated on an official Riot/Microsoft page fetched in this session, or verified on a local machine
confidence_legend.medium: official page but summary ambiguous, or inferred from official text

global_caveats: Riot's VAN articles mostly do NOT list formal causes; 'common_causes' are the causes implied by the official fix steps unless marked otherwise.
Riot's own VAL error list page is flagged by Riot as 'currently out of date' (display-bug note). Treat VAL meanings as approximate.

Riot's VAN: RESTRICTION article contains a confusing line about builds ('Build 26100 or newer is supported only on Windows 11. Windows 10 users must upgrade to Windows 11') and the specs page contradicts itself on Windows 10 minimum build (19041+ vs 10904). See vanguard_requirements.os_support.
Vanguard On-Demand / Pre-Check (June 2026) means vgc service may legitimately be Manual/Stopped when no Riot game runs. A fix tool must NOT blindly force vgc to Automatic - see tool_design_notes.
Never ask users to upload raw ShooterGame.log / CrashContext.runtime-xml publicly: they contain auth tokens in the command line, PUUID-like subject, MachineId, LoginId.
meta.counts_note: error_codes[] contains every VAN article Riot currently lists (47) plus the VAL codes from Riot's VAL list (grouped where Riot gives identical meaning/fix).

vgc_automatic.official: Win+R > services.msc > find 'vgc' > Properties > Startup type Automatic > Start if stopped > Apply > restart PC. Skip if the user enabled Vanguard Pre-Check (on-demand).

manual_vanguard_uninstall.official: Exit Riot Client and Vanguard from tray; uninstall via tray (Advanced > Uninstall Vanguard) or Settings > Apps; if it will not uninstall: elevated cmd 'sc delete vgc' and 'sc delete vgk', restart, delete the leftover 'Riot Vanguard' folder in Program Files; launch the Riot Client / game to reinstall Vanguard.

restore_windows_security.official: Elevated cmd: 'bcdedit /set TESTSIGNING off' and 'bcdedit /set nointegritychecks OFF' (skip the second if Windows replies it is protected by Secure Boot policy); restart.

clean_boot.official: Perform a Windows clean boot (msconfig: hide Microsoft services, disable the rest; disable startup apps) to find background software interfering with Vanguard.

time_date.official: Verify Windows date, time and time zone are correct (wrong clock breaks services and secure connections).

gather_logs.official: If nothing helps: Riot Repair Tool (RRT, run as admin) -> select VALORANT -> attach generated .zip to a Player Support ticket.

common_fix_steps.safe_test_note: Riot recommends testing after each step in Practice Tool / custom game to avoid penalties in matchmade games (stated on VAN 59/68/193/9101 pages).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard requires a Windows update or a Windows/BIOS security feature to be enabled before the game can launch; the error message itself names the requirement (Windows update, TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, Memory Integrity (HVCI/VBS), or IOMMU). Applies to the un-numbered variant only.
common_causes: Windows older than minimum build (article: minimum build 19045 or newer)
TPM 2.0 / Secure Boot / Memory Integrity (HVCI/VBS) / IOMMU not enabled

Account or HWID flagged so Vanguard enforces stricter boot-security checks (Riot dev blog 2025-12-18: applied at account or HWID level; not an accusation of cheating, means config resembles those used by cheaters)
Motherboard firmware that reports Pre-Boot DMA Protection before IOMMU is fully initialized (needs BIOS update)
official_fixes: If message says Windows update: install all Windows updates (min build 19045 per article), restart
If message names a feature: enable it (TPM 2.0 guide, Secure Boot guide, Memory Integrity guide, IOMMU guide), restart
If IOMMU 'update motherboard firmware' warning: note BaseBoard Manufacturer/Product in msinfo32, flash latest BIOS, then re-check IOMMU is still enabled
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - check each requirement (see vanguard_requirements.checks): OS build via registry, tpmtool getdeviceinformation, SecureBoot\State registry, Win32_DeviceGuard, IOMMU only partially (Win32_DeviceGuard AvailableSecurityProperties contains 3 = DMA protection; msinfo32 Kernel DMA Protection; BIOS IOMMU setting itself needs admin/UEFI and is not directly readable). Also compare BIOS release date against vendor advisories (ASUS CVE-2025-11901, Gigabyte CVE-2025-14302, MSI CVE-2025-14303, ASRock CVE-2025-14304, CERT VU#382314).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify that Secure Boot is enabled and working correctly.
common_causes: System not booted in UEFI mode (Legacy/CSM)
official_fixes: Enable Secure Boot per Riot guide, restart, relaunch
If Secure Boot already enabled: update BIOS, relaunch
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State UEFISecureBootEnabled (verified readable without admin); Confirm-SecureBootUEFI needs admin; disk partition style (Get-Disk) must be GPT; BIOS version/date via Win32_BIOS.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the game from the drive where it is installed.
common_causes: Game installed on a drive other than the one running Windows (external USB or secondary internal drive)
official_fixes: Find the drive containing the Windows folder (usually C:)
Uninstall and reinstall the game on that same internal drive
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - read install path from C:\ProgramData\Riot Games\RiotClientInstalls.json / Metadata\*\*.product_settings.yaml and compare drive letter to $env:SystemDrive. (This machine's game root: C:/Riot Games/VALORANT/live/ per CrashContext BaseDir.) Auto-fix = reinstall, not safe to automate; just guide.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify your PC's Secure Boot configuration (page title/error text: 'Secure Boot verification failure'). Verified by two fetches quoting the first paragraph.
common_causes: Secure Boot disabled or misconfigured (article lists no separate causes)
official_fixes: Ticket with RRT logs if persists
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as RESTRICTION: 1 (SecureBoot\State, GPT, UEFI). Also check secure boot key state (see VAN: STATUS_SB_POLICY).
error_codes.note: Distinction between RESTRICTION 1 and 4 is not explained by Riot; both name Secure Boot. 4 may mean configuration/policy verification vs 1 = enabled-and-working.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify that Memory Integrity (HVCI/VBS, part of Windows Core Isolation) is enabled and running correctly.
common_causes: CPU virtualization (Intel VT-x / AMD SVM) not enabled in BIOS
NX/XD (No Execute / Execute Disable) disabled in BIOS (stated on the LoL/2XKO mirrors of this article)
Required BIOS/UEFI security setting not configured
official_fixes: Enable Memory Integrity: Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > Memory integrity On (guide)
If VBS 'enabled but not running' in msinfo32: enable VT-x+XD (Intel) or SVM+NX (AMD) in BIOS; ensure Hyper-V / Windows Hypervisor Platform feature not disabled
If toggle greyed/incompatible driver: review incompatible drivers, update/uninstall (old anti-cheat, RGB, hardware drivers common); list drivers with 'dism /online /get-drivers /format:table'
Restart, relaunch; ticket with RRT logs
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - Win32_DeviceGuard: VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus (2=running), SecurityServicesRunning contains 2 (HVCI); registry ...\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity Enabled=1 (verified on test machine: status 2, services running {2}, Enabled=1); systeminfo 'Virtualization-based security: Status: Running'. Incompatible drivers: Event log Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational and 'Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemDriver'.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard found software or a driver that fails its security requirements ('Incompatible software component detected'); the error shows the offending file path (.sys).
common_causes: Incompatible software/driver identified by file path in the message
VPN or proxy used to connect to the game server (article lists as connection cause)
official_fixes: Note the file path in the error
Uninstall the associated software (Settings > Apps > Installed apps / Programs and Features), restart
If cannot uninstall: delete the flagged .sys file, restart
Configure DNS per Riot DNS guide

community_fixes.fix: Frequently flagged files per community guide: ene.sys (RGB lighting controllers), rtcore64.sys (MSI Afterburner/RivaTuner older versions). Remove/update that software.

error_codes.detectable_locally: Partly - Riot names no list. Tool can (a) list loaded third-party kernel drivers (Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemDriver | State=Running), (b) read Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational events (3077 = blocked by blocklist/policy, 3033/3063 = unsigned/policy failures), (c) match against a community watch-list (ene.sys, rtcore64.sys, etc.) flagged confidence low, (d) detect VPN/proxy adapters and WinINET/WinHTTP proxy settings. Riot does NOT publish a block list.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard detected a problem communicating with the Intel Volume Management Device (VMD) controller: 'The VMD controller has encountered a fatal unrecoverable error. Process will terminate.'
common_causes: Communication problem with Intel VMD controller, most common on systems using Intel Rapid Storage Technology (RST) driver
official_fixes: Install the correct Intel RST driver: prebuilt PCs from OEM support site (Lenovo/Legion, HP/OMEN, Dell/Alienware, ASUS/ROG, MSI, Acer/Predator, Surface); custom builds from Intel's generic RST driver page
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - Storage controllers via Get-PnpDevice -Class SCSIAdapter / 'Intel RST VMD Controller' name, driver provider/version via Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPSignedDriver; flag iaStorVD.sys / iaStorAC.sys old versions; BIOS 'VMD Controller' setting not readable.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard detected a driver that doesn't meet its security requirements. Named cases: Intel VMD/RST (iastorvd.sys), third-party NVMe/SATA drivers (secnvme.sys, solidnvm.sys, asstahci64.sys), MediaTek RZ616 Wi-Fi 6E driver (mtkwl6ex.sys) older than 3.5.
common_causes: Samsung/Solidigm-style third-party NVMe drivers secnvme.sys / solidnvm.sys
MediaTek RZ616 Wi-Fi 6E driver v3.4 or lower
official_fixes: iastorvd.sys: install Intel RST driver from Intel 'RST Installation for 12th to 15th Gen Platforms' (download ID 930427), restart
secnvme.sys / solidnvm.sys: Device Manager > Storage controllers > Update driver > Browse > Let me pick > 'NVM Express Controller' (Microsoft)
asstahci64.sys: switch to 'Standard SATA AHCI Controller' (Microsoft); verify Provider = Microsoft Corporation
mtkwl6ex.sys: update RZ616 Wi-Fi driver to >= 3.5 via Windows Update > Optional updates or Microsoft Update Catalog
Different driver named: ticket with driver name + RRT logs
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - this is the best auto-detectable driver code. Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemDriver / Win32_PnPSignedDriver and look for ImagePath/filenames iastorvd.sys, secnvme.sys, solidnvm.sys, asstahci64.sys, mtkwl6ex.sys (+ MediaTek RZ616 driver version < 3.5). Can offer guided swap to Microsoft driver (needs user confirmation; risk of boot failure -> do not automate silently).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard could not verify the device's Secure Boot policy ('The secure boot policy on this device could not be verified.'). Can occur even when Secure Boot is ON.
common_causes: Secure Boot database not at factory default / bad keys
official_fixes: Reset Secure Boot keys to factory default (BIOS > Key Management > Restore Factory Keys / Install Default Secure Boot Keys), even if Secure Boot is enabled. Suspend BitLocker or have recovery key first.
Restart and relaunch; ticket with RRT logs
error_codes.detectable_locally: Partly - Secure Boot on/off readable; key database contents need admin: Get-SecureBootUEFI -Name PK/KEK/db (admin) and compare; (Get-SecureBootPolicy). BitLocker status via Get-BitLockerVolume (admin) / manage-bde -status to warn before key reset. Auto-fix not possible from OS (BIOS operation).

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Riot Vanguard isn't running; the client closes automatically because Vanguard is required.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - vgc service state/start type (sc qc vgc), vgk driver service (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\vgk, Start value; ImagePath exists), existence of C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgk.sys/vgc.exe, vgc_*.log being written.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting or staying connected while the game launches/runs.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - clock vs NTP (w32tm /stripchart or compare with HTTP Date header; note W32Time service was Stopped on the test machine, error 0x80070426), time zone (Get-TimeZone), vgc state, connectivity to Riot hosts.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready during launch/gameplay.
common_causes: vgc not running or not set to auto-start
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN -104.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard detected an unsupported system configuration (client closes).
common_causes: Computer or OS doesn't meet Riot's system requirements (article links League of Legends requirements page - note the page is a shared Vanguard article)
official_fixes: If requirements met: ticket with RRT logs
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - OS arch (64-bit), build, CPU SSE4.2/AVX, DirectX 11, ARM detection (PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE), VM detection, RAM.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready while the game launches/runs.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN -104.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready during launch/play.
common_causes: Connection problems between Vanguard and game
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN -104.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready while the game launches/runs. (VAL list page also describes -81 as 'service start failed'.)
common_causes: vgc not running if not auto-start
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN -104; also 'sc query vgc' / 'sc query vgk' errors and System event log (Service Control Manager 7000/7009/7023/7031 for vgc/vgk).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming it's ready; in-game text: 'VALORANT has encountered a connection error. Please relaunch the client to reconnect.'
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN -104.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming it's ready while the game launches/runs.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN -104.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard was unable to start correctly or one of its required services is unavailable.
official_fixes: Manually uninstall Vanguard, restart, relaunch to reinstall
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - vgc/vgk service presence, start type, state; vgk.sys exists; kernel driver loaded (sc query vgk, or fltmc / driverquery).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify that the PC is ready to run the game or hit a problem while starting up.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - pending Windows updates (Get-WindowsUpdateLog / COM Microsoft.Update.Session search for IsInstalled=0), vgc state, OS build vs minimum.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready to run the game or had an issue while initializing.
common_causes: Windows updates changing system services Vanguard relies on
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN 0.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't finish one of its startup or system trust checks. Client text: 'An unexpected error with Vanguard has occurred and the client will now close.'
common_causes: Windows security settings preventing verification (e.g. test signing / integrity checks off)
official_fixes: Restore Windows security to normal (bcdedit TESTSIGNING off, nointegritychecks OFF)
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - bcdedit /enum {current} (admin) shows testsigning / nointegritychecks / debug / bootmenupolicy; auto-fix: bcdedit /set TESTSIGNING off (admin, requires user OK + reboot). Also HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CI\Config (VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable).

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard isn't running or couldn't start correctly. Client text: 'An unexpected error with Vanguard has occurred and the client will now close.'
official_fixes: Set vgc Automatic (unless Pre-Check), restart if changed
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - vgc start type/state, vgk driver, tray process vgtray.exe. NOTE: with Pre-Check/On-Demand, vgc Manual is expected.

error_codes.official_meaning: Usually means Vanguard ran into an unexpected issue while starting or communicating with the Riot Client (can close the client). NOT the same as VAL 59.
common_causes: Temporary launch/connection problem between Vanguard and Riot Client
official_fixes: Fully close and reopen Riot Client
error_codes.detectable_locally: Partly - multiple RiotClientServices.exe instances, vgc state, Riot Client Logs.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard lost the connection or session it needs while the game was launching or running.
common_causes: Killer Network Service traffic prioritization (only official code page that names it)
official_fixes: Turn off Killer Network Service, relaunch
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - Killer Network Service present/running (Get-Service 'Killer Network Service' / 'Killer*'), clock, vgc.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready to run the game or errored while starting up.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN 0.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't complete one of its startup or system trust checks. (VAL list page: 'connection error'.)
common_causes: Windows debugging setting: debug memory dumps enabled
official_fixes: Restore Windows security to normal state
Disable debug memory dumps: sysdm.cpl > Advanced > Startup and Recovery > Settings > Write debugging information = (none) > OK, restart
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl CrashDumpEnabled (0 = none; test machine had 3 = small dump; per Riot this setting is a VAN 128 trigger, medium confidence since article only says 'debug memory dumps'), bcdedit flags. Auto-fix candidate: set CrashDumpEnabled=0 (needs admin + user consent since it disables crash dumps).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready or hit an error while starting up (not a general connection error).
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN 0.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready or had an issue while initializing.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN 0.

error_codes.official_meaning: Game/Vanguard is running in a virtual machine or unsupported virtualized environment (not supported). Shows as 'Connection Error: VALORANT encountered a connection error. Please relaunch the client to reconnect.'
common_causes: Running in a VM / virtualized environment
Firewall blocking Riot Client from servers
official_fixes: Run on a standard (physical) Windows PC, not a VM
Configure firewall to allow Riot Client
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - Win32_ComputerSystem Manufacturer/Model (VMware, VirtualBox, QEMU, Microsoft Corporation 'Virtual Machine'), Win32_BIOS, SMBIOS strings, HypervisorPresent (WARNING: HypervisorPresent=True on a physical PC with VBS/HVCI running - do NOT use it alone; verified True on the test machine's real hardware), CPUID hypervisor vendor, Windows Firewall rules for Riot executables.

error_codes.official_meaning: Startup or connection issue involving VALORANT, Riot Client and Vanguard; typical text is a connection error asking to relaunch the client.
common_causes: Windows launch/permission behavior interfering between Riot Client, game and Vanguard
official_fixes: On game shortcut and RiotClientServices.exe: Properties > Compatibility > 'Disable fullscreen optimizations', 'Run this program as an administrator', Change high DPI settings > Override high DPI scaling = Application

community_fixes.fix: Some third-party blogs claim VAN 140 = 'unsupported Windows version'. Riot's own article does NOT say this - ignore.

error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - AppCompatFlags\Layers registry (HKCU/HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\Layers) for the exe paths: DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE, RUNASADMIN, HIGHDPIAWARE flags. Auto-fix feasible: write those layer values (HKCU, no admin needed for HKCU).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard ran into an unexpected issue while starting or checking in with your system (client closes).
common_causes: Windows permission conflicts between Riot Client/game/Vanguard
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - AppCompatFlags RUNASADMIN on RiotClientServices.exe, UAC level (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System EnableLUA), vgc.

error_codes.official_meaning: The device is restricted from playing due to a hardware ID (HWID) ban after a review found an account on this device violated User Rules (Section 7) of the Terms of Service. NOT a Vanguard install/connection problem. (VAL list page: typically lasts 4 months.)
common_causes: Buying/using second-hand hardware previously used for cheating (Riot treats logging in on an HWID-banned PC as ban evasion)
official_fixes: No technical fix. Reinstalling Vanguard/game, changing connection or restarting does not lift it.
See 'Understanding Hardware ID (HWID) Bans'; review possible via Player Support (separate ticket per account), not guaranteed
error_codes.detectable_locally: NO - purely server-side. Tool must NOT attempt any 'fix', spoofer or HWID workaround; show the official explanation and the appeal link only. Can only detect that the user sees VAN 152 in Riot Client logs.

error_codes.official_meaning: Session or connection issue between the game, Riot Client and Vanguard.
common_causes: Riot Client session conflict with another PC
official_fixes: Log out of Riot Client on any other PC

community_fixes.fix: Third-party guides call VAN 185 'not an official/unconfirmed' code - false; Riot lists it.

error_codes.detectable_locally: Partly - min-spec check, enumerate USB/HID devices (Get-PnpDevice -Class HIDClass,USB -Status OK), connectivity checks.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard had trouble starting or communicating correctly with the Riot Client.
official_fixes: Delete vgkbootstatus.dat so Vanguard recreates it
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - count RiotClientServices.exe/RiotClientUx.exe instances; vgkbootstatus.dat existence (location not stated by Riot: typically C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\ - UNVERIFIED, medium/low; on test machine the file was not in the top-level folder listing, so search C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard and C:\ProgramData\Riot Games); bcdedit flags. Auto-fix candidate: delete vgkbootstatus.dat after stopping vgc/Riot Client.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard ran into an unexpected issue while starting or checking in with your system. Typically shows as a connection error asking to relaunch the client; can disconnect from a match. (Also the Windows system error number 1067 'The process terminated unexpectedly' - for the vgc service this is the same event.)

community_fixes.fix: Remove Audinate Dante Controller / Dante virtual soundcard driver if installed (one Reddit-sourced anecdote reported by The Spike).

error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - System event log: Service Control Manager event 7034/7031/7023 for 'VALORANT' / 'vgc' with 'terminated unexpectedly'; HID/USB devices; Defender status (Get-MpComputerStatus); vgc state.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready or had an issue while initializing.
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - same as VAN 0.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard doesn't detect TPM 2.0 as enabled. Text: 'This build of Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 to be enabled in order to play.'
common_causes: TPM 2.0 (Intel PTT / AMD fTPM / discrete) disabled in BIOS
Older BIOS/AGESA bug where TPM reports not ready even though enabled
official_fixes: Enable TPM 2.0 per Riot TPM guide (tpm.msc must show 'ready for use' + Specification Version 2.0), launch again
If tpm.msc says ready but error persists: note Manufacturer Version, update BIOS (AMD older AGESA affected), re-check fTPM/PTT still enabled
Note: discrete TPM satisfies VAN 9001 but VAN: RESTRICTION needs firmware TPM (Intel PTT/AMD fTPM)
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - 'tpmtool getdeviceinformation' (works without admin; verified: TPM Present/Version 2.0/Manufacturer/Ready For Attestation), Get-PnpDevice -Class SecurityDevices (verified: 'Trusted Platform Module 2.0', ACPI\MSFT0101), Get-Tpm and Win32_Tpm WMI need ADMIN (verified: Access denied / empty as normal user), tpm.msc.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard can't find a required Windows security feature enabled: Windows Exploit Protection is disabled/altered.
common_causes: Exploit Protection system settings changed from default (CFG, DEP, Mandatory ASLR, Bottom-up ASLR, High-entropy ASLR, SEHOP, Heap integrity)
Per-program Exploit Protection overrides on Riot/Vanguard executables
official_fixes: Exploit Protection > System settings: set each of CFG, DEP, Mandatory ASLR, Bottom-up ASLR, High entropy ASLR, SEHOP, Heap integrity validation to 'Use default' (do not restart yet)
Program settings: remove every entry for Riot Games / Riot Vanguard / any Riot title
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - Get-ProcessMitigation -System (verified works; DEP Enable: NOTSET = default) and Get-ProcessMitigation -Name <exe> / Get-ProcessMitigation for Riot exes; any non-default or per-program Riot entry = finding. Auto-fix: Set-ProcessMitigation -System -Reset? (use Set-ProcessMitigation -Name <exe> -Remove / -Disable overrides) - admin; recommend resetting only the Riot entries and the listed system toggles back to NOTSET.

error_codes.official_meaning: Secure Boot is not enabled. Text: 'This build of Vanguard requires secure boot to be enabled in order to play.'
common_causes: Legacy/CSM boot or MBR disk (Secure Boot requires UEFI + GPT)
official_fixes: Enable Secure Boot per Riot guide (msinfo32: BIOS Mode UEFI + Secure Boot State On; GPT required; mbr2gpt /validate /allowFullOS then /convert /allowFullOS for MBR disks - irreversible, back up first; BIOS: UEFI mode, CSM off, Secure Boot Enabled; Restore Factory Keys if greyed out)
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - SecureBoot\State\UEFISecureBootEnabled registry (no admin), Confirm-SecureBootUEFI (admin; verified errors for normal user), Get-Disk PartitionStyle (verified), msinfo32 BIOS Mode, 'bcdedit /enum {bootmgr}' path \EFI\... indicates UEFI. mbr2gpt /validate needs admin.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard requires 'Windows 10 20H1 or newer' but doesn't detect that version on the PC.
common_causes: Windows build older than 20H1 (19041) or missing updates
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - CurrentBuild/UBR/DisplayVersion registry and Win32_OperatingSystem.BuildNumber (verified: 26200, 25H2, UBR 9711).
error_codes.note: Fetch summary of the 9004 and 9006 pages are near-identical; 9004 vs 9006 wording may differ slightly.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 and UEFI-compliant firmware to use Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) but can't detect that security setup.
common_causes: Memory Integrity / VBS not running correctly
official_fixes: Restart and relaunch after each change
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - combine TPM + Secure Boot + Win32_DeviceGuard checks.

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard requires Windows 10 version 20H1 or newer and can't detect it; may also appear as 'VAN9006: This version of Vanguard requires Windows 20H1 or later and may not function as expected' (a warning in the Vanguard tray notification center).
common_causes: Windows build older than 20H1, or missing updates
official_fixes: Check Vanguard notification center in system tray
error_codes.detectable_locally: Yes - OS build (same as 9004).

error_codes.official_meaning: Vanguard hit an internal error it couldn't recover from ('encountered a critical error and cannot continue'); client closes so Vanguard can start fresh.
common_causes: Internal Vanguard failure (no specific cause listed; temporary Vanguard errors)
official_fixes: Manual Vanguard uninstall + restart + relaunch (reinstalls with default settings)
error_codes.detectable_locally: Partly - vgc/vgk presence and state; Vanguard logs are encrypted (cannot parse); Windows crash events for vgc.exe (Application log 1000/1001).

vanguard_requirements.summary: As of 2026-10-21, Vanguard has a base requirement set (64-bit Windows 10 20H1+/Windows 11, UEFI + Secure Boot + TPM 2.0 on Windows 11, no VMs, no ARM) and a growing 'enforced when flagged' set (VAN: RESTRICTION: TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, Memory Integrity/HVCI+VBS, IOMMU, Windows build, firmware update) applied at account/HWID level. Riot says only a small fraction of players are currently forced into the stricter set. Vanguard Pre-Check/On-Demand (June 24, 2026) is an OPTIONAL mode available only if the strict set is all met.

os_support.officially_listed: Windows 10 (build 19041+, 64-bit) and Windows 11 (64-bit). Specs page ALSO contains a contradicting line 'Windows 10 support starts at Build 10904' (typo/outdated). VAN 9004/9006 say Windows 10 20H1 (=19041) minimum. VAN: RESTRICTION page says minimum build 19045 (=Windows 10 22H2) for the restriction case and an unclear line 'Build 26100 or newer is supported only on Windows 11. Windows 10 users must upgrade to Windows 11 to keep playing.'
history: 2026-05 (GamerDoc X post quoting Riot, secondary/low): 'VALORANT and Vanguard still support Windows 10'; stricter requirements hit only a small fraction of flagged players, which may need security features only in some Windows 11 builds
os_support.on_demand_pre_check_min: Windows 11 version 25H2 or newer (official Pre-Check page)
os_support.uncertainty: Treat 19041 as hard minimum, 19045 (22H2) as 'recommended safe floor', and 25H2 as On-Demand floor. Re-check Riot pages before shipping. Windows 10 consumer end-of-support was 2025-10-14 (Microsoft).

hardware.cpu: SSE 4.2 or AVX; DirectX 11 GPU; 64-bit; ARM unsupported
hardware.specs_30fps_min: Intel i3-540 / AMD Athlon 200GE, Intel HD 4000 / Radeon R5 220, 4 GB RAM (+1GB VRAM if discrete)
hardware.specs_144fps_high: i5-9400F / Ryzen 5 2600X, GTX 1050 Ti / R7 370 / Arc A310, 4 GB RAM

requirements.name: TPM 2.0
requirements.enforcement: Required on Windows 11 (base requirement with Secure Boot); error VAN 9001 / 9090 / 9005; also checked under VAN: RESTRICTION. Firmware TPM (Intel PTT / AMD fTPM) needed for RESTRICTION; discrete TPM OK for 9001.

how_to_check_locally.reads: TPM Present, TPM Version (want 2.0), Manufacturer, Is Initialized, Ready For Storage, Ready For Attestation, Clear Needed To Recover
Device present and Status OK (ACPI\MSFT0101 = TPM 2.0). FriendlyName is localized (Turkish: 'Guvenilir Platform Modulu 2.0') so match on InstanceId ACPI\MSFT0101 / MSFT0200 not name
Status text + Specification Version

requirements.name: UEFI Secure Boot (+ GPT disk, UEFI mode)
requirements.enforcement: Required on Windows 11; errors VAN 9003, VAN: RESTRICTION 1 / 4, STATUS_SB_POLICY. Windows 10 not hard-required unless flagged/RESTRICTION.

how_to_check_locally.reads: 1 = on; key missing = Legacy BIOS/unsupported

how_to_check_locally.verified: fails with 'Unable to set proper privileges' as normal user
how_to_check_locally.reads: True/False; throws on Legacy BIOS
Windows disk must be GPT
Key database presence/contents for STATUS_SB_POLICY (factory-default check)

how_to_check_locally.cmd: msinfo32 -> BIOS Mode / Secure Boot State / PCR7 Configuration

requirements.name: Memory Integrity (HVCI) + Virtualization-Based Security
requirements.enforcement: Enforced when VAN: RESTRICTION: 5 / VAN 9005; required for Vanguard Pre-Check (On-Demand).
prerequisites: CPU virtualization enabled in BIOS: Intel VT-x (+ XD) / AMD SVM (+ NX)
Hyper-V / Windows Hypervisor Platform not disabled

how_to_check_locally.reads: VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus: 0 off / 1 enabled-not-running / 2 running. SecurityServicesRunning: 1 Credential Guard, 2 HVCI (Memory Integrity), 3 System Guard Secure Launch, 4 SMM firmware measurement. AvailableSecurityProperties: 1 base virtualization, 2 Secure Boot, 3 DMA protection, 4 secure memory overwrite, 5 UEFI code readonly, 6 SMM mitigations, 7 MBEC, 8 APIC virtualization. Test machine: status 2, running {2}, available 1,2,3,5,6,7,8
1 = Memory Integrity configured on (configured, not necessarily running)
'Virtualization-based security: Status: Running'; localized on non-English Windows - prefer WMI

how_to_check_locally.cmd: msinfo32 -> 'Virtualization-based security' and 'Virtualization-based security services running'

how_to_check_locally.reads: Blocked / incompatible drivers (HVCI block events 3033/3034/3063/3064/3077)

requirements.autofix: Enabling Memory Integrity via registry (HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity Enabled=1, EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity=1) is possible with admin + reboot, but can cause BSOD with incompatible drivers; Riot's recovery step: from WinRE cmd 'reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity" /v Enabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f'. Recommend guiding (Windows Security UI) not silent enabling.

requirements.name: IOMMU (Intel VT-d / AMD IOMMU, AMD-Vi) in BIOS; Kernel DMA Protection
requirements.enforcement: Riot enabled IOMMU enforcement for accounts flagged for DMA-cheat use (Wikipedia: 2026-05-19); baseline in dev blog 2025-12-18 alongside Secure Boot and VBS; required for Pre-Check. Riot says Vanguard checks the BIOS IOMMU setting, NOT that Windows reports Kernel DMA Protection 'On'.
triggers_errors: VAN: RESTRICTION (message names IOMMU / 'update motherboard firmware')

bios_names.intel: VT-d; 'Control IOMMU Pre-boot Behavior' = Enable IOMMU during boot (ASUS: Advanced > System Agent Configuration; MSI: OC > CPU Features; Gigabyte: Settings > Miscellaneous > Intel VT-d; ASRock: Advanced > Chipset Configuration > VT-d)
bios_names.amd: IOMMU (AMD-Vi); plus DMA Protection and DMAr Support where present (ASUS: Advanced > AMD CBS > IOMMU / NBIO Common Options; MSI/ASRock: AMD CBS > NBIO Common Options > IOMMU; Gigabyte: Settings > Miscellaneous > IOMMU)

how_to_check_locally.reads: Indicates Windows sees DMA remapping/Kernel DMA Protection capability - good proxy, medium confidence
Per Riot: Off or missing is usually acceptable; on Off still enable IOMMU in BIOS. (msinfo32 /report to a text file failed in my headless test; GUI works - low confidence for scripting)
IOMMU initialization events (if log exists) - low confidence
Compare to vendor's BIOS release that fixes CVE-2025-11901 (ASUS), CVE-2025-14302 (Gigabyte), CVE-2025-14303 (MSI), CVE-2025-14304 (ASRock); test machine MSI MS-7E02, BIOS A.D0, released 2025-08-04

requirements.limits: BIOS IOMMU toggle itself is not readable from OS; a local tool can only infer and then instruct the user. Full shutdown (not restart) recommended after changing; some boards reset setting after a failed boot.

requirements.name: CPU virtualization (VT-x/SVM) and NX/XD
requirements.enforcement: Prerequisite of VBS/HVCI; RESTRICTION 5 frequently caused by NX/XD off (per LoL/2XKO mirror of the article, medium).

how_to_check_locally.reads: VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled false when a hypervisor is active is common - unreliable when VBS already running; treat VBS status as the truth
DEP/NX available

Manufacturer/Model for VMware/VirtualBox/QEMU/'Microsoft Corporation Virtual Machine'. WARNING: HypervisorPresent is True on physical PCs when VBS/HVCI/Hyper-V is on (verified True on real MSI hardware).
64-bit and not ARM64

requirements.name: Windows security not tampered (test signing, integrity checks, debug)

how_to_check_locally.cmd: bcdedit /enum {current}  (look for testsigning, nointegritychecks, debug, loadoptions DISABLE_INTEGRITY_CHECKS)
how_to_check_locally.verified: fails (invalid entry type / needs elevation) as normal user
how_to_check_locally.autofix: bcdedit /set TESTSIGNING off ; bcdedit /set nointegritychecks OFF (skip if Secure Boot policy protects)

how_to_check_locally.reads: 0 none, 1 complete, 2 kernel, 3 small, 7 automatic; Riot VAN 128 fix says set to (none)
Exploit Protection overrides (VAN 9002)

requirements.name: Microsoft vulnerable driver blocklist / third-party kernel drivers
requirements.enforcement: Riot publishes NO explicit tie to the Microsoft blocklist. Vanguard blocks drivers by its own rules (VAN: Incompatible Software / OEM Driver). Microsoft's April 2026 security updates added protections against known-vulnerable kernel drivers (e.g. psmounterex.sys); blocked loads log Event ID 3077 in Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational. Interaction with Vanguard is NOT confirmed (low).

how_to_check_locally.reads: 1 = blocklist enabled (test machine: 1). Also in Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation > 'Microsoft Vulnerable Driver Blocklist'.

how_to_check_locally.needs_admin: log read may need elevation on some systems
how_to_check_locally.reads: Drivers blocked or failing code integrity

how_to_check_locally.cmd: Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemDriver | Where-Object State -eq 'Running' | Select Name,PathName
how_to_check_locally.reads: Loaded kernel drivers to match watch-list

requirements.name: Motherboard firmware pre-boot DMA protection fix
requirements.enforcement: Dev blog 2025-12-18: stricter boot-security checks for certain players; Riot investigating extending to all players Ascendant rank and above (no date). Fix = enable Secure Boot/VBS/IOMMU or update BIOS.

how_to_check_locally.reads: Show to user with link to vendor BIOS page; tool cannot know which BIOS version contains the fix (no machine-readable list) - flag any BIOS older than ~2025-12 as 'check for update', confidence low

van_restriction_variants.VAN: RESTRICTION: Generic; the on-screen text names what is needed (Windows update, TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, Memory Integrity, IOMMU, or 'update motherboard firmware').
van_restriction_variants.VAN: RESTRICTION: 3: Game not on the same internal drive as Windows
van_restriction_variants.VAN: RESTRICTION: 2: Not listed by Riot (index shows only 1,3,4,5). Unknown.
van_restriction_variants.who_gets_them: Account/HWID-level, when Vanguard detects suspicious hardware behavior/statistical anomalies or a config resembling cheater setups (dev blog 2025-12-18). Not an accusation. Pre-Check page: Vanguard tray (VGTray) shows which requirement needs attention.

vanguard_on_demand.what: Optional 'Vanguard Pre-Check': driver (vgk) and vgc start when a Riot game starts and shut down after, instead of at Windows boot. Requires Windows 11 25H2+, Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, IOMMU, VBS, HVCI. Reportedly ~35% of players qualify (FinalBoss, secondary/low).
vanguard_on_demand.implication_for_tool: On the test machine vgc StartMode=Manual and State=Stopped, vgk Start=1 (system) - do not treat as an error. Riot's own error pages say 'set vgc Automatic unless you use Pre-Check'.

services_and_components.vgk: Kernel driver, C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgk.sys (service name vgk; test machine Start=1 System)
services_and_components.vgc: User-mode service, C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard\vgc.exe (service name vgc; test machine StartMode Manual)
services_and_components.vgtray: vgtray.exe tray UI; shows requirement status and notification center

useful_signals: First line 'LogInit: OS: Windows 11 (25H2) [10.0.26200.xxxx], CPU: <model>, GPU: <model>, Disk: SSD' - OS/CPU/GPU/disk type

'Fatal error', 'D3D device being lost (Error: 0x887A0005 REMOVED)' - GPU crash/TDR
LogNet disconnects, packet loss and ping lines during matches (search 'LogNet', 'Disconnect')

log_locations.name: Vanguard logs
log_locations.readable: NOT readable. Verified: files start with binary header 'pvpv' followed by high-entropy data, not text. Intended for Riot (RRT / log-uploader.exe collect and send them). A local tool can only use metadata: file existence, creation/modify times, size, count.

Many tiny logs in short time => crash-restart loop (e.g. 7 KB log then restart)

incompatible_software.statement: Riot does NOT publish a list of incompatible/conflicting software. Its 'VAN: Incompatible Software' article names no program (only a placeholder IncompatibleDriver.sys); the in-error file path identifies the culprit. Riot does name specific drivers on 'VAN: Incompatible OEM Driver' (see below).

official_named_drivers.fix: Install Intel RST driver (download ID 930427) for 12th-15th gen platforms
Switch to Microsoft 'Standard SATA AHCI Controller'

official_named_drivers.what: MediaTek RZ616 Wi-Fi 6E driver version 3.4 or lower
official_named_drivers.fix: Update to 3.5+ via Windows Update optional updates / Microsoft Update Catalog
Install correct Intel RST driver from OEM or Intel

official_other_conflicts.item: Virtual machines / virtualized environments / cloud gaming
VPNs and proxies used to connect to game servers
Windows Exploit Protection overrides on Riot executables or non-default system mitigations
Test signing / integrity checks off / debug memory dumps
Old kernel drivers (older anti-cheat, RGB, hardware drivers) that block Memory Integrity

community_watchlist_low_confidence.item: Hardware monitoring tools (VALORANT beta era report about MSI Afterburner)

incompatible_software.microsoft_blocklist_note: Microsoft's vulnerable driver blocklist is a separate mechanism; no Riot statement ties it to Vanguard (low confidence).

tool_design_notes: Do NOT force vgc to Automatic if Vanguard Pre-Check/On-Demand is in use (vgc Manual + stopped when idle is normal; verified on test machine). Only recommend it when the user reports VAN 0/6/25/57/-1/-72..-104/128/133/135/148/193/1067/2266 AND Pre-Check is not active (no obvious public registry flag found - ask the user or check VGTray).

Many checks work as a normal user: tpmtool getdeviceinformation, Get-PnpDevice -Class SecurityDevices, SecureBoot\State registry, Win32_DeviceGuard, DeviceGuard registry, Get-Disk, Win32_BIOS/BaseBoard, CI Config registry, CrashControl registry, Get-ProcessMitigation -System. Admin needed: Get-Tpm, Win32_Tpm, Confirm-SecureBootUEFI, Get-SecureBootUEFI, bcdedit, BitLocker status, Minidump read.
Windows UI language can be non-English (test machine is Turkish): match device InstanceIds and WMI numeric values, not localized names or systeminfo text.

Auto-fix candidates that are safe/reversible: AppCompat flags for VAN 140/148; deleting vgkbootstatus.dat (stop services first); reset Exploit Protection overrides for Riot exes (VAN 9002); Windows time resync (w32tm /resync, start W32Time service); bcdedit testsigning off (admin + reboot); CrashDumpEnabled=0 for VAN 128 (inform user crash dumps disabled).

Guide-only (never automate): BIOS settings (TPM, Secure Boot, IOMMU, VT-x/SVM, NX), Secure Boot key reset (BitLocker lockout risk), MBR2GPT, driver swaps for storage controllers (boot failure risk), enabling HVCI with incompatible drivers (BSOD risk), BIOS flashing.
VAN 152 / VAL 61 / HWID bans: never offer fixes or HWID changing; show Riot's explanation and appeal link only.
Never parse or upload Vanguard logs (encrypted); for ShooterGame.log and crash XML redact CommandLine, -remoting-auth-token, -subject, MachineId, LoginId, UserName before any export.
open_questions_to_recheck_before_shippin: Exact Windows 10 minimum build in 2026 (19041 vs 19045 vs 'Windows 11 only' hint on VAN: RESTRICTION page).
Whether VAN: RESTRICTION: 4 differs from 1 (both Secure Boot).
How to programmatically detect that Vanguard Pre-Check/On-Demand is enabled.
Which BIOS versions per vendor contain the pre-boot DMA fix (no machine-readable list found).
Reliable scripted read of 'Kernel DMA Protection' (msinfo32 /report did not produce a file in a headless test).
